entities.name_th: สถานีคุณภาพอากาศ คพ. (Air4Thai)

upstream.agency: Pollution Control Department (กรมควบคุมมลพิษ)

entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Official reference-grade PM2.5/PM10 at a handful of fixed stations; the province average is a mean of the few reporting.

mustNotConclude.th: ค่าที่สถานีไม่ใช่ค่าทั้งจังหวัด และสถานีที่เงียบตอนกลางคืนไม่ได้แปลว่าอากาศดี
mustNotConclude.en: A station reading is not the whole province, and a station gone quiet overnight is not clean air

entities.failureMode: Provincial stations go quiet overnight; the board reports 0 fresh monitors rather than carrying yesterday's reading forward.

entities.name_th: เซนเซอร์ DustBoy (มช.)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Low-cost optical PM2.5 sensors, dense across the basin; one hourly batch, outliers flagged against provincial peers.

mustNotConclude.th: ค่าเซนเซอร์ราคาประหยัดไม่ใช่ค่าอ้างอิงทางการ ห้ามใช้แทนประกาศ คพ.
mustNotConclude.en: A low-cost sensor value is not an official reference reading and must not stand in for a PCD notice

entities.failureMode: The feed is one hourly batch, not 236 independent clocks; after 3 h the board says stale. log_datetime is UTC despite looking Bangkok-local.

entities.name_th: ฝุ่นละอองทั้งคอลัมน์ (แบบจำลอง CAMS)
entities.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo), attributed
entities.fidelity: Global model aerosol optical depth for one grid cell; regional context, not a local measurement.

mustNotConclude.th: AOD ทั้งคอลัมน์ไม่ใช่ PM2.5 ที่ผิวดินและไม่ใช่เกณฑ์สุขภาพ
mustNotConclude.en: Column AOD is not surface PM2.5 and not a health threshold

entities.failureMode: A model, not a measurement; one grid cell, so map dots are scaled copies of it. Missing → no model output, never clear sky.

entities.name_th: โฟโตมิเตอร์ AERONET เชียงใหม่
entities.licence: NASA open data, attributed
entities.fidelity: Ground sun-photometer daily AOD and Ångström exponent at one site; tells smoke from dust, not surface concentration.

mustNotConclude.th: วันที่ไม่มีข้อมูลเพราะเมฆบังไม่ได้แปลว่าอากาศสะอาด
mustNotConclude.en: A day missing because of cloud is not a clean day

entities.failureMode: Cloud-screened: cloudy days are simply missing, not zero. A gap in the series is not a clean day.

entities.name_th: PM2.5 รายอำเภอ (GISTDA)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Satellite/model-derived PM2.5 per district; fills the gaps between stations at district resolution.

mustNotConclude.th: ค่ารายอำเภอจากดาวเทียมไม่ใช่การวัดที่ผิวดิน ต้องตรวจกับสถานีภาคพื้น
mustNotConclude.en: A satellite district value is not a surface measurement; cross-check with ground stations

entities.failureMode: A tile service, not a documented API; shape changes surface as unavailable, never as a reading.

entities.name_th: จุดความร้อน NASA FIRMS (VIIRS)
entities.licence: NASA open data, attributed
entities.fidelity: Thermal anomalies from VIIRS passes over the Chiang Mai box, published within ~3 h of the pass.

mustNotConclude.th: ไม่มีจุดความร้อนไม่ได้แปลว่าไม่มีไฟ — เมฆและเวลาโคจรบังได้
mustNotConclude.en: No hotspot is not no fire — cloud and pass timing can hide it

entities.failureMode: A 1-day window can return a valid empty body indistinguishable from no fires; the module fetches 2 days as the liveness proof and reports 24 h. Failure → illustrated scenario, never scored.

entities.name_th: จุดความร้อนกรมป่าไม้

upstream.agency: Royal Forest Department (กรมป่าไม้)

entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Seven-day accumulation of agency hotspots classified by land tenure (reserve, park, community forest).

mustNotConclude.th: จุดสะสม 7 วันไม่ใช่ไฟที่กำลังไหม้อยู่
mustNotConclude.en: A 7-day accumulation is not fire burning now

entities.failureMode: Often 0 in the Chiang Mai box for days; an unreachable host is reported unavailable, not zero.

entities.name_th: ทิศทางควัน (คำนวณแนวตรง)
entities.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo), attributed
entities.fidelity: 1/3/6 h straight-line advection of live VIIRS hotspots inside 350 km by surface wind.

mustNotConclude.th: เส้นทางควันแนวตรงไม่ใช่การพยากรณ์การกระจายตัว
mustNotConclude.en: A straight-line plume is not a dispersion forecast

entities.failureMode: Drawn only from a live VIIRS pass; without one provenance is unavailable and no segment is drawn.

entities.name_th: ระดับน้ำแม่น้ำ (สถานีวัด)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Telemetered water level at Ping-basin gauges against bank height; the projection runs at the edge, not on the relay.

mustNotConclude.th: ระดับน้ำที่สถานีไม่ได้บอกว่าน้ำท่วมถึงบ้านใคร — ต้องดูพื้นที่ที่อยู่ใกล้สถานีด้วย
mustNotConclude.en: A station level does not tell you whose house is flooded — you need the area near the gauge too

entities.failureMode: ThaiWater rate-limits Cloudflare egress (429), so the relay reads it; relay copies older than 45 min fall back to the direct read, which may 429 and leave the axis blind.

entities.name_th: ฝนสะสม 24 ชม. (สถานีวัด)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Measured 24 h rainfall at ~340 Chiang Mai gauges (DWR, RID, TMD, HII), banded on TMD classes.

mustNotConclude.th: ฝนที่วัดได้ที่สถานีไม่ได้แปลว่าฝนตกเท่ากันทั้งลุ่มน้ำ
mustNotConclude.en: Rain at a station is not rain across the whole basin

entities.failureMode: Relay silent > 60 min, or no gauge reading inside 6 h → unavailable: rainfall is unknown, not zero.

entities.name_th: ปริมาณน้ำในเขื่อน (รายงานกรมชลประทาน)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: RID daily report: storage, % of normal storage, inflow, release and spill for Ping-basin large dams and Chiang Mai reservoirs.

mustNotConclude.th: เปอร์เซ็นต์ที่เก็บน้ำไม่ใช่น้ำที่ปล่อย — ดูอัตราการระบายด้วย
mustNotConclude.en: Storage percentage is not discharge — read the outflow rate too

entities.failureMode: A daily report, not a sensor; reports older than 2 days are dropped. Relay silent > 3 h → unavailable: storage is unknown, not normal.

entities.name_th: พยากรณ์น้ำท่วม Google Flood Hub
entities.licence: Data CC BY 4.0; API terms limit use to non-commercial
entities.fidelity: 7-day riverine model forecast at virtual gauges; none of the 12 nearest Chiang Mai is quality-verified.

mustNotConclude.th: ไม่มีการพยากรณ์น้ำท่วมไม่ได้แปลว่าปลอดภัย และจุดเสมือนไม่ใช่สถานีวัดจริง
mustNotConclude.en: No forecast flooding is not safety, and a virtual gauge is not a physical one

entities.failureMode: Model only; newest issuance older than 30 h is stale. No key or no answer → unavailable, outlook unknown, never safe.

entities.name_th: สนามพยากรณ์ฝนและลม 48 ชม.
entities.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo), attributed
entities.fidelity: ~30 km model grid of hourly wind, precipitation and PM2.5 for 48 h, shared in KV and refreshed at most every 3 h.

mustNotConclude.th: แบบจำลองช่องละ ~30 กม. มองไม่เห็นพายุในหุบเขา ไม่ใช่คำเตือนทางการ
mustNotConclude.en: A ~30 km model cell cannot see a valley storm, and it is not an official warning

entities.failureMode: Refresh failure serves the last run only while it still covers now, else unavailable and no field is drawn; missing PM2.5 → 'no PM2.5 forecast', never 'clean'.

entities.name_th: ประกาศเตือนภัยทางการ (กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา)
entities.licence: Public domain (marked in the CAP feed)
entities.fidelity: TMD's signed CAP 1.2 alerts filtered to TH-50 or polygons touching the province, passed through as issued.

mustNotConclude.th: ไม่มีประกาศ TMD ที่มีผลไม่ได้แปลว่าปลอดภัย
mustNotConclude.en: No active TMD alert is not an all-clear

entities.failureMode: Feed unreachable or throttled → unavailable, cached 30 min; the board says no TMD alert is in effect, never safe.

entities.name_th: ส่งออก CAP 1.2 ของกระดาน
entities.licence: Restricted scope: decision support, not a public warning
entities.fidelity: The board's own active outlook and verdict items as CAP 1.2 with scope=Restricted, for integrators.

mustNotConclude.th: ไม่ใช่ประกาศเตือนภัยทางการ แหล่งทางการคือ กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา และ ปภ.
mustNotConclude.en: Not an official public warning; official sources are TMD and DDPM

entities.failureMode: An output of this board, not an observation; it inherits every input's gaps.

entities.name_th: ศูนย์พักพิงชั่วคราว

upstream.agency: Chiang Mai Provincial Office (สำนักงานจังหวัดเชียงใหม่)

entities.licence: Per gdcatalog dataset licence; geocodes © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
entities.fidelity: 177 official shelters geocoded at building, subdistrict or district precision; every point carries its precision.

mustNotConclude.th: ตำแหน่งโดยประมาณไม่ใช่ที่ตั้งจริงของอาคาร และรายชื่อไม่ได้บอกว่าศูนย์เปิดอยู่
mustNotConclude.en: An approximate point is not the building, and the list does not say a shelter is open

entities.failureMode: The official list has no coordinates; rows the provincial office verifies override any geocode. A rebuild is manual.

entities.name_th: กล้องสาธารณะ
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Positions and reachability of public cameras in the operations box; no video is recorded.

mustNotConclude.th: กล้องที่เข้าถึงได้ไม่ได้แปลว่ามีคนเฝ้าดูอยู่
mustNotConclude.en: A reachable camera does not mean anyone is watching it

entities.failureMode: Hosts drop in and out (4 of 9 Longdo reachable at last check); unreachable cameras are listed as such.

entities.name_th: กล้องเฝ้าระวังน้ำท่วม (Maholan)
entities.licence: Community catalogue, credited verbatim
entities.fidelity: Catalogue metadata for the flood cameras inside the Chiang Mai box; stills are fetched by the viewer, not stored.

mustNotConclude.th: ภาพนิ่งจากกล้องไม่ใช่การวัดระดับน้ำ
mustNotConclude.en: A camera still is not a water-level measurement

entities.failureMode: A 906 KB national catalogue with no filter; failure → unavailable with the last catalogue time.

entities.name_th: ประเมินหมอกควันจากภาพกล้อง

upstream.agency: Windy webcams, scored on the relay

entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Image statistics from a few cameras turned into a haze screening verdict; no images are kept.

mustNotConclude.th: คำตัดสินจากภาพเป็นการคัดกรอง ไม่ใช่การวัดฝุ่น
mustNotConclude.en: An image verdict is screening, not a dust measurement

entities.failureMode: Agreement requires varied paired readings and at least 3 independent station IDs in a 3-hour high-reading window; this is an engineering corroboration gate, not validated detection accuracy. Relay silent > 45 min → unavailable.

entities.name_th: ตรวจคุณภาพภาพแม่น้ำ

upstream.agency: Department of Water Resources snapshots via FloodDash

entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Image quality and repeated-pixel checks on three pinned public DWR riverside snapshots; not flood detection, water segmentation, depth or flow measurement.

mustNotConclude.th: ภาพที่ตรวจได้ไม่ยืนยันน้ำท่วม ระดับน้ำ หรือความปลอดภัยของถนน
mustNotConclude.en: An inspectable image is not flood detection, a water-level measurement or road-safety evidence

entities.failureMode: Relay batch silent > 45 min → unavailable. Capture timestamps are aged separately at 45 min; unknown capture time, low light, low detail or repeated old pixels never establish current water conditions. Manifest clock is relay-push, not camera capture.

entities.name_th: รายงานจากประชาชนและสื่อท้องถิ่น

upstream.agency: Reddit and local news, geocoded with OSM

entities.licence: Headlines quoted with attribution; gazetteer © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
entities.fidelity: Place-pinned haze mentions at the precision the text supports, without author identity.

mustNotConclude.th: การกล่าวถึงไม่ใช่การยืนยันเหตุการณ์ และตำแหน่งระดับอำเภอไม่ใช่ที่อยู่
mustNotConclude.en: A mention is not a confirmed event, and a district-level pin is not an address

entities.failureMode: Relay silent > 3 h → unavailable; a district-level mention is never drawn as a street address.

entities.name_th: ข่าวและการรับฟังสื่อ
entities.licence: Headlines quoted with attribution (Google News, GDELT)
entities.fidelity: Thai and English headlines about the province, toned by keyword; a reading of coverage, not of events.

mustNotConclude.th: พาดหัวข่าวไม่ใช่การยืนยันสถานการณ์
mustNotConclude.en: A headline is not a confirmed situation

entities.failureMode: Relay copy older than 20 min falls back to direct reads; cold-start placeholders are badged and excluded from the answer corpus.

entities.name_th: อากาศยาน (ADS-B)
entities.licence: OpenSky terms (non-commercial), attributed
entities.fidelity: ADS-B state vectors around CNX; low traffic is normal and is not an outage.

mustNotConclude.th: เครื่องบินน้อยลำเป็นค่าปกติของสนามบินนี้ ไม่ใช่ระบบล่ม
mustNotConclude.en: Few aircraft is normal here, not a fault

entities.failureMode: Relay snapshot older than 3 min is ignored and the route reports degraded rather than freezing positions.

entities.name_th: เที่ยวบินขาเข้าและนักท่องเที่ยวโดยประมาณ
entities.licence: OpenSky terms (non-commercial), attributed
entities.fidelity: Observed flights per day by origin country; passenger numbers are estimated from seat capacity × 82% load factor.

mustNotConclude.th: จำนวนผู้โดยสารเป็นค่าประมาณ ไม่ใช่สถิติทางการ
mustNotConclude.en: Passenger counts are estimates, not official statistics

entities.failureMode: Relay copy older than 6 h is treated as a dead relay and ignored.

entities.name_th: เรดาร์ฝนและภาพดาวเทียม
entities.licence: Open, attributed (RainViewer, NASA GIBS)
entities.fidelity: Tile layers for radar precipitation, Himawari infrared and daily MODIS AOD; pictures, not values.

mustNotConclude.th: ภาพเรดาร์และดาวเทียมเป็นภาพ ไม่ใช่ค่าที่วัดได้ ณ จุด
mustNotConclude.en: Radar and satellite tiles are pictures, not point measurements

entities.failureMode: GIBS has no 'latest' endpoint; times are probed newest-first and a layer with no resolvable time is omitted.

entities.name_th: ความลึกเชิงแสงฝุ่น JAXA GCOM-C
entities.licence: Proprietary (JAXA); licence travels with the response
entities.fidelity: Newest daily SGLI aerosol scene, walked back from today.

mustNotConclude.th: AOT จากดาวเทียมไม่ใช่ PM2.5 ที่ผิวดิน
mustNotConclude.en: Satellite AOT is not surface PM2.5

entities.failureMode: No scene resolvable within the walk-back → unavailable with the reason; access generates a log, so the route is rate-limited.

entities.name_th: ดัชนีข้อมูลเปิด data.go.th
entities.licence: Per-dataset licence on data.go.th
entities.fidelity: A dated snapshot of one filtered Thai-language search, not a population count of the catalogue.

mustNotConclude.th: จำนวนชุดข้อมูลในดัชนีไม่ใช่จำนวนทั้งหมดของจังหวัด
mustNotConclude.en: The dataset count is one search's snapshot, not the province's total

entities.failureMode: Baked by a manual script with no cron, so it drifts silently; amber past 14 days.

entities.name_th: ประเมินหมอกควันข้ามแดน ASMC
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Regional hotspot counts and haze assessment, when a working host and key exist.

mustNotConclude.th: ไม่มีข้อมูล ASMC ไม่ได้แปลว่าไม่มีหมอกควันข้ามแดน
mustNotConclude.en: No ASMC data is not an absence of transboundary haze

entities.failureMode: No public API host is known; the module returns needs-key rather than a fabricated reading. No SLO until it is wired.

entities.name_th: ลำน้ำ (OpenStreetMap)
entities.licence: ODbL (© OpenStreetMap contributors)
entities.fidelity: Mapped river and canal lines; geometry, not water.

mustNotConclude.th: เส้นลำน้ำไม่ได้บอกว่ามีน้ำหรือน้ำท่วม
mustNotConclude.en: A mapped waterway says nothing about water in it

entities.failureMode: Baked; falls back to live Overpass only if the bake is missing.

entities.name_th: เส้นทางรถโดยสาร
entities.licence: ODbL (© OpenStreetMap contributors)
entities.fidelity: Mapped route lines and stops; not timetables or live positions.

mustNotConclude.th: เส้นทางที่แมปไว้ไม่ได้บอกว่ารถวิ่งอยู่
mustNotConclude.en: A mapped route does not say a bus is running

entities.failureMode: Baked; a self-fetch through the edge failed intermittently, so it reads through the ASSETS binding.

entities.name_th: โบราณสถาน
entities.licence: Curated reference list
entities.fidelity: A short curated list of old-city sites for orientation.

mustNotConclude.th: รายการนี้ไม่ใช่ทะเบียนโบราณสถานทางการ
mustNotConclude.en: This is not the official heritage register

entities.failureMode: Static; cannot fail except by being out of date.

entities.name_th: ร่องรอยการเผาไหม้ (สสน.)
entities.licence: Not stated by the publisher; public keyless endpoint, attributed on the panel
entities.fidelity: Seasonal burn-scar tiles proxied same-origin; a season's footprint, not current fire.

mustNotConclude.th: ร่องรอยการเผาไหม้ไม่ใช่ไฟที่กำลังไหม้
mustNotConclude.en: A burn scar is not a fire burning now

entities.failureMode: Upstream tile miss returns an empty tile; season layers are static.

excludedRoutes.cap.atom: Atom index of the cap-export entity's alerts; same content, another envelope.
excludedRoutes.warning-log: Verification log of this board's own level changes; an output, not a feed.
excludedRoutes.ask: Question answering over the feeds listed here; not a feed.
excludedRoutes.twin: The province verdict, derived from the feeds listed here.
excludedRoutes.story: Narrative over the feeds listed here.
excludedRoutes.flood: Drill scenario only; answers unavailable without ?scenario= (measured water is river-level, rain, dam).
excludedRoutes.outbound: A view over the flights feed.
excludedRoutes.visitors: An estimate derived from the flights feed.
excludedRoutes.ingest: Relay write endpoints (any …/ingest); they receive feeds, they do not serve them.
